purpose: Offline, auditable ground-truth labeled corpus for source classification evaluation

source_datasets.name: EOG Global Gas Flaring Catalog
source_datasets.provider: Earth Observation Group (EOG), Colorado School of Mines / World Bank GFMR

targets_used.name: Jamnagar Refinery South Flare Stack West (Process Area)
Jamnagar Refinery South Flare Stack East (Process Area)
Jamnagar Refinery North Flare Stack Cluster A1-A4

match_thresholds.WEAK_MATCH: 1.0 < D_ellipse <= 1.5 (Downgraded to Tier 3, Excluded from training targets)

temporal_rules.GAS_FLARE: Operational window intersection with continuous refinery flaring inventory
temporal_rules.WILDFIRE_VEGETATION: Burn date within +/- 2 days of verified perimeter dispatch
temporal_rules.AGRICULTURAL_BURN: Requires independent non-satellite agricultural burn permit/dispatch

label_credibility_rules.TIER_1: Direct verified ground truth with sub-hour precision (Eligible for training)
label_credibility_rules.TIER_2: Strong independent external corroboration (e.g. EOG Flare Catalog; Eligible for training)
label_credibility_rules.TIER_3: Contextual spatial evidence or weak boundary matches (Strictly excluded from training)
label_credibility_rules.TIER_4: Heuristic, inferred, or uncorroborated detections (Strictly excluded from training)

GAS_FLARE.reason: Verified EOG persistent flaring stack centroids.

WILDFIRE_VEGETATION.reason: UNAVAILABLE_FOR_INITIAL_SUPERVISED_TRAINING: No independent verified wildfire incident perimeters in Jamnagar regional corridor during study window.

AGRICULTURAL_BURN.reason: UNAVAILABLE_FOR_INITIAL_SUPERVISED_TRAINING: Strict rejection of circular satellite-derived stubble labels (ICAR-CREAMS/WorldCover). No non-satellite farm dispatch records available.

INDUSTRIAL_FIRE.reason: UNAVAILABLE_FOR_INITIAL_SUPERVISED_TRAINING: Zero verified PESO/CSB accidental explosion records. Off-zone 11.97 MW anomaly preserved as ambiguous exclusion.

OTHER.reason: 110 unassociated regional observations preserved without fabricating synthetic labels.
